note: PyTorch for the P1+ path (doc/r38_pytorch_p1plus.md): torch.compile -> Inductor -> Triton -> the tnca backend. 2.14.0 because it is the release that depends on triton~=3.8.0, the locked frontend; Inductor's generated Triton follows the version torch pins. Installed into its own environment (TORCH_PYTHON), never into TRITON_PYTHON, so no existing gate gains a dependency. Kept out of spec/r1_toolchain.lock.json on purpose: that file's hash is in every artifact's identity, and torch is not part of the TNCA compile toolchain, so pinning it there would change every artifact without changing any code.
install: python3 -m venv <env>/torchenv && <env>/torchenv/bin/pip install torch==2.14.0 numpy && install tnca (registers the triton.backends entry point)
